_comment: Benchmark sets for `perf-round.js bisect`. checkpoints are {name, pending?}: pending:true means the save may not exist yet (Task 6 creates the perf-* ones); bisect skips such a checkpoint only if its save is absent (R13). rungs are PerfLayerGate layers (l0..l5). windows are rest|walk|talk. R12: only ladderCheckpoint runs the set's rungs; every other checkpoint runs rung 5 only, and walk/talk windows are taken only at rung 5 (every other rung runs a stationary rest window, which L1/L2 require).
